remarks: Fully renovated from wall to wall, this brand-new 3-bedroom, 1-bath ground-level apartment at 64 Soundview Avenue offers bright, clean, move-in-ready living with no stairs. The unit has been completely updated throughout with new flooring, fresh walls, recessed lighting, new windows, and a modern open layout. The kitchen features new cabinetry, sleek countertops, tile backsplash, and updated appliances, while the full bathroom has been fully redone with contemporary finishes. All three bedrooms offer fresh, neutral space, making the layout flexible and easy to live in. Convenient ground-level access is a major perk, offering single-level living with no interior stairs. Nothing to do but move right in and enjoy a completely refreshed apartment in a convenient Stamford location.
